ele.rationale: Retain the original predeclared 1 m tolerance; covers integer export precision, not elevation accuracy.

tmp.rationale: One stored integer unit, predeclared before this climate batch; no relative tolerance.

pre.rationale: One stored integer unit, predeclared before this climate batch; annual sums retain the same 1 mm tolerance.

pass_rule: Every pair is present, fully covered and within its declared absolute tolerance. A passed numerical comparison does not establish source-version equivalence or independent scientific reproduction.
scientific_release_gate: Not eligible: independent operator rerun, original native zone-grid equivalence and exact input-vintage review are still required.
source_rules: Reference imports must come from the intact original BasinATLAS v1 level-12 geodatabase, preserving raw precision and nodata.
Every one of the 281 attributes must retain its catalogue reference, stored unit, physical-unit conversion, spatial support and original temporal meaning.
Never average upstream attributes over the pilot. Candidate upstream calculations use unique contributing sub-basins and additive weighted sums.
WorldClim V1 hosted in Earth Engine is a candidate source; the catalogue's v1.4 identity and historical-period description require review even if values match.
Do not use modern replacement datasets to claim original-atlas reproduction.
Missing raw source inputs mean reconstruction pending, not a fabricated value or an implemented reproduction.
